label: TLR signalling and inflammatory cytokine regulation
reason: Members regulate Toll-like/IL-1 receptor signalling and the resulting cytokine output (TNF, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, IFN-alpha); Dengue apoptosis is a lone outlier.

label: Nucleic acid deamination editing and antiviral restriction
reason: APOBEC/ADAR editing and antiviral restriction form a core; about four translational-silencing/frameshifting terms (L13a, elongation/initiation repression) do not belong.

label: ER protein targeting, folding and ER-Golgi transport
reason: SRP/tail-anchored ER insertion, ER folding/quality control, COPII/COPI trafficking and connexin secretory transport are all early secretory pathway.

label: cAMP/Ca2+-CREB and MECP2 neuronal activity transcription
reason: cAMP-PKA/CaMK-CREB memory signalling and MECP2 regulation are linked by activity-dependent neuronal gene transcription (CaMKIV, NPAS4, MECP2 phosphorylation).

label: Adherens junctions and epithelial polarity
reason: Cadherin-based adherens junction assembly, apical-basal polarity and EMT restraint form a single epithelial junction theme.

label: Ventricular myocardium and septum morphogenesis
reason: All members concern cardiac muscle tissue morphogenesis: septa, trabeculae, compact myocardium and cardiomyocyte development.

label: Nuclear ncRNA processing, exosome decay and telomerase RNP
reason: rRNA/snoRNA/snRNA processing and exosome surveillance plus telomerase assembly/Cajal-body localization, linked because telomerase RNA is a Cajal-body scaRNA-type RNP sharing this machinery.

label: TLR/TNF downstream TAK1-IKK-NF-kB/JNK signalling
reason: IRAK/TRAF6/TRIF-RIP1 activation of TAK1 and IKK leading to NF-kB, JNK and p38 is one innate signalling cascade.

label: Cardiovascular development: heart, valves, vessels
reason: Heart chamber/valve/septum morphogenesis, endocardial EMT, BMP signalling and arterial/vascular development form one cardiovascular development theme; one B-cell module is an outlier.

label: SLCO organic anion and drug transport
reason: Organic anion/xenobiotic transmembrane transport by SLCO transporters, including Rotor syndrome and drug ADME entries.

label: Insulin/glucagon control of glucose and lipid metabolism
reason: Insulin and glucagon signalling, GLUT4, glycogen, gluconeogenesis, ChREBP and triglyceride regulation are one fuel-homeostasis axis.

label: Mitotic spindle, centrosome and cytokinesis
reason: Centrosome/MTOC function, spindle assembly and orientation, PLK1/AURKA and cytokinesis; cilium assembly terms fit via centrosome-basal body cycling.

label: tRNA processing, modification and aminoacylation
reason: Nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and charging dominate; a few rRNA/mRNA modification terms are close relatives.

label: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA catabolism and B-vitamin cofactors
reason: Fatty acid oxidation, BCAA/lysine catabolism and 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases are linked to cobalamin, biotin, thiamine, riboflavin, lipoate and CoA metabolism as their required cofactors (organic acidemias).

label: Antigen processing and presentation (MHC II, CD1)
reason: MHC class II peptide and CD1 lipid antigen presentation with NKT cell regulation; TLR7 entries relate to APC function.

label: Gene expression machinery: transcription, RNA processing, translation
reason: Pol I/II/III transcription, splicing, mRNA export/stability, tRNA and translation are sequential steps of gene expression, tied by MYC-driven biosynthesis; a few odd terms.

label: Cell cycle: mitosis, meiosis and DNA replication
reason: E2F/G1-S, DNA replication licensing, G2/M, APC/C, spindle, cohesion and meiotic chromosome segregation all belong to cell-division control.

label: Telomere maintenance
reason: Telomerase extension, capping, C-strand synthesis, ALT recombination and telomerase RNA Cajal-body localization are all telomere maintenance.

label: Integrin-Rap1-Rho adhesion signalling and platelet activation
reason: Integrin linkage to MAPK, Rap1 and Rho/G12-13 signalling and cytoskeletal remodelling, connected to platelet activation through Rap1-driven inside-out integrin activation.

label: Microtubule and centrosome organization, tubulin modification
reason: Microtubule nucleation, anchoring, severing, stability and tubulin polyglutamylation all concern the microtubule cytoskeleton and centrosome.

label: Actin dynamics in protrusion and cell motility
reason: Lamellipodia, filopodia, ruffles, Arp2/3 and actin polymerization/severing are a single actin-based motility theme.

label: Autophagy and lysosomal fusion
reason: Selective autophagy (mito-, pexo-, reticulo-, aggrephagy), autophagosome maturation and lysosome fusion are one degradative pathway.

label: NER, translesion synthesis and repair DNA synthesis
reason: Nucleotide excision repair, translesion polymerases, PCNA polymerase switching and gap-filling DNA synthesis form one DNA-damage tolerance/repair theme.

label: Motile cilia and flagella function
reason: Axoneme/dynein arm assembly, multiciliogenesis, sperm motility, CSF flow, mucociliary clearance and nodal-cilia left-right asymmetry all depend on motile cilia.

label: Chondrocyte and osteoblast differentiation, ossification
reason: Cartilage condensation, chondrocyte maturation, RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation and endochondral/intramembranous ossification.

label: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and skin appendages
reason: Keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, cornification, skin barrier and hair follicle/sebaceous/nail development; mammary and lumen cavitation are minor outliers.

label: Xenobiotic metabolism and detoxification
reason: Phase I/II drug metabolism (CYP, FMO, UGT, sulfonation, methylation, acetylation), transport and bilirubin conjugation form one detoxification theme.

label: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and drug excretion
reason: Bile acid synthesis/transport and sterol absorption joined with bilirubin and xenobiotic transport through shared hepatobiliary excretion transporters (ABCC2, ABCB11, SLCO1B).

label: Striated muscle development, regeneration and hypertrophy
reason: Myoblast differentiation/fusion, satellite cells, calcineurin-NFAT, sarcomere assembly and cardiac/skeletal muscle adaptation; replacement ossification is an outlier.

label: Hexose and pentose metabolism and absorption
reason: Fructose, galactose, pentose phosphate and polyol metabolism with intestinal sugar digestion/transport and their inborn errors.

label: Rho-family GTPase cycles
reason: RHO, RAC and CDC42 GTPase cycles and their effectors (WASP/WAVE, formins, IQGAP) controlling actin.

label: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and Rho/Rac
reason: Members dampen integrin adhesion, focal adhesion and Rho/Rac-driven lamellipodia, a single adhesion-turnover theme.

label: Epithelial branching morphogenesis of glandular organs
reason: Lung, prostate and salivary branching driven by epithelial-mesenchymal signalling; a few unrelated organ terms (ductus arteriosus, diaphragm) are minor.

label: Post-transcriptional mRNA regulation, decay and miRNA silencing
reason: miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, ARE-binding protein decay, deadenylation, decapping and 3' processing all regulate mRNA fate.

label: Cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
reason: IL-2/3/5/6/7/9, EPO, TPO, GH, prolactin, leptin and FLT3/PDGFR-fusion STAT5 signalling share the JAK-STAT cytokine receptor mechanism.

label: Dendritic spine and synaptic plasticity
reason: Dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic actin, reelin and LTP/LTD plasticity form one postsynaptic structural theme.

label: Craniofacial and pharyngeal organ development
reason: Face, palate, ear and pharyngeal-derived glands (thyroid, parathyroid, thymus) form a core; limb, spleen, mammary and muscle terms (about a quarter) lie outside it.

label: Nuclear pore transport and SUMOylation
reason: Nucleocytoplasmic transport/NPC dynamics and the SUMO pathway are linked mechanistically (RanBP2 SUMO E3 and SENP desumoylases sit at the nuclear pore).

label: Endocrine control of body growth
reason: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and thyroid hormone signalling/transport tied by organismal growth regulation; neutral amino acid transport links via LAT1 thyroid hormone/leucine transport.

label: TNFR1-NF-kB signalling and ubiquitin/DUB regulation
reason: TNFR1/NF-kB signalling joined with linear/K63 ubiquitination and deubiquitinases (OTU, USP) that specifically control that pathway.
